title: Mill
tagline: Nine men. Three in a line.

lines.en: Nine men each. Three in a line. One small mill.
lines.zh: 每人九子，三点一线，围成一个“磨”。

lines.en: Mill. Nine Men's Morris for the family table.
lines.zh: 九子棋。给家里牌桌的九人莫里斯。

lines.en: Place all nine, then slide one man along the lines.
lines.zh: 先摆下九子，再沿棋盘线走子。

lines.en: Close a mill, remove a rival man. Men in mills stay protected.
lines.zh: 成三即可吃子；磨中的棋子受到保护。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a four-ply Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到四层搜索的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或让手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints that explain, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 会解释的提示、悔棋、自动保存与家庭战绩。

lines.en: Mill. Three in a line, one family table.
lines.zh: 九子棋。三点一线，一张家里的牌桌。
